newsitem.title: USA: Qualcomm, Sony venture wins $80 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Qualcomm, Sony venture wins $80 mln deal.

text.p: Qualcomm Personal Electronics on Tuesday said it has received an $80 million order for CDMA-based digital communications handsets from U S West Communications Group.

Qualcomm Personal Electronics is a venture between Qualcomm Inc and Sony Corp formed to manufacture digital communications equipment based on Qualcomm's code division multiple access (CDMA) technology.
Qualcomm shares were up 1-7/8 to 56-1/2 by mid-afternoon.
The order was for Qualcomm's QCP-1900 and Sony's CM-D600 Personal Communications Service phones.
In a statement, Qualcomm said U S West will sell the CDMA-based equipment in 53 markets in the United States, beginning in Denver, Colorado in 1997's second quarter.
